logp.method_description: n-Octanol/water partition coefficients (log Po/w) of the complexes were calculated by following the standard literature procedure. (58) An equal volume of both solvents was taken and mixed thoroughly for around 12 h using a vortex shaker to make a presaturated solution. Then, it was left undisturbed for 24 h, and consequently, two different phases (organic/water) were formed. A small quantity of complex was added into the solution mixture (3 mL of n-octanol presaturated with water and vice versa). The solutions were mixed again using the shaker and subsequently centrifuged for 10 min at 5000 rpm. The concentrations of the complexes in both the phases were finally evaluated through UV–Vis spectra. CO and CW denote the concentration of the complexes in n-octanol and water, respectively. The partition coefficient (log Po/w) values of the complexes were calculated by the following equation: log Po/w = log (CO/CW).
